2. To protect your mental health immediately, seek out a confidential support group like Al-Anon (for loved ones of alcoholics) or a therapist, which will give you a safe outlet without feeling like you are exposing him to your friends or family.

5. Finally, begin quietly protecting yourself practically by opening a private bank account and saving whatever small amounts you can, ensuring you have a financial safety net if you ultimately decide you need to leave.
